projects.title: Love Your Own
projects.description:
Kosova's economy had been struggling during the first post-war decade, finding it difficult to manufacture goods and trade with neighbouring countries. As a newly founded country, it was facing difficulties with trade agreements and political skirmishes, faced with very little support by the government.

During a trade crisis with Serbia in 2011, we came up with an idea to promote the local products through a call to action campaign to support Kosovar producers, by making these products more visible in the markets and stores.
